web_fixture.title: Hartmoor Barista One - error codes
web_fixture.snippet: Meanings and first steps for the Barista One error codes.
web_fixture.content:
# Error codes - Hartmoor Barista One

- E-02 | Cause water tank is empty | Action refill the tank and reseat it
- E-07 | Cause limescale in the thermoblock | Action run the descale program
- E-09 | Cause brew unit lost its home position | Action power cycle the machine

If the code returns after the listed step, book a service visit.
